research_question: What minimum activation gain preserves a measurable event-driven activation response while eliminating the E2 activation debt pathology under D2/D6? Secondary: if only u_a = 0 passes the debt gates, is positive-only activation injection structurally problematic rather than merely over-gained?

metrics.reuse: E2 definitions exactly: O_a+, N_a+, activation quantiles, strong_debt, quiet_debt, saturation episodes, baseline occupancy, event sensitivity J, discounted-load reconstruction, quiet recovery, partition consistency, restore/replay

gates.statement: Protocol integrity: frozen manifest binds E2 protocol hash, E2 corpus root, E2/E1 source fingerprints, sequence hashes, seed subset, variants, gates, accounting (108), zero-model, production isolation. All runs validate.
Input identity: for each family+seed the event sequences consumed by A0/A10/A20 are byte-identical (persisted sequence hash equality).
Bounds/finite: all states finite, 0 <= a <= 1, and a >= .2 - 1e-12 (nonnegative impulses, baseline .2).
Valence invariance: for every family/seed and common timestamp |v_A0 - v_A10| and |v_A10 - v_A20| <= 1e-12. Violation => INVALID_EXPERIMENT.
Recovery invariant: during declared event-free windows each variant satisfies a(t) = .2 + (a_s-.2)*exp(-(t-s)/150) within 1e-12; quiet_debt = 0.
D6 debt: Q95_seed(strong_debt) <= .05 (the original E2 failure criterion, authoritative).

D3 responsiveness: unsaturated MID/STRONG/EDGE events fraction(Delta_a + 1e-12 >= .005) >= .75; pooled all-q>0 ordinary events fraction(Delta_a + 1e-12 >= .002) >= .25. Frozen before the official run; A0 is expected to fail this by construction.
Strong event response: D3/D7 unsaturated events with q >= .25 have median Delta_a >= .02 for a variant to qualify as an activation candidate.
Partition equivalence: D6-S00 all variants tick1/tick10/direct max_abs_error <= 1e-12 on both axes.
Restore equivalence: D6-S00 all variants restore continuation vs uninterrupted max_abs_error <= 1e-12, no historical replay.
Replay law: same ID + same payload -> REPLAY delta 0; same ID + changed payload -> CONFLICT; different ID + same payload -> APPLIED (all variants).
A20 reproduction: at least one A20 D6 seed has strong_debt > .05 (the E2 identified risk must reproduce on the reused subset); the aggregate subset result is reported.
Gain identity: unsaturated identical events satisfy Delta_a(A10) ~= .5*Delta_a(A20) and Delta_a(A0) = 0 within 1e-12 (implementation integrity).

selection_logic.debt_gates: G6 (D6) and G7 (D2) — a variant 'passes debt' when both hold
selection_logic.responsiveness_gates: G9 and G10 — a variant 'passes responsiveness' when both hold
selection_logic.case_A: A10 passes debt + responsiveness and A20 fails debt => ACTIVATION_GAIN_REDUCTION_SUPPORTED (candidate u_a = .10q)
selection_logic.case_B: A10 and A20 both fail debt while A0 passes debt but fails responsiveness => POSITIVE_ONLY_ACTIVATION_MAPPING_NOT_SUPPORTED
selection_logic.case_C: A10 and A20 both pass debt => E2_ACTIVATION_RISK_NOT_REPRODUCED; if additionally A20 shows no D6 seed with strong_debt > .05 => INVALID_EXPERIMENT (corpus identity investigation)
selection_logic.case_D: A10 passes debt but fails responsiveness => GAIN_REDUCTION_INSUFFICIENTLY_RESPONSIVE
selection_logic.case_E: A0 passes responsiveness => INVALID_EXPERIMENT (protocol defect: u_a = 0 cannot respond)
selection_logic.case_F: core integrity failure (G2-G5, G11-G13, G15) => INVALID_EXPERIMENT / MECHANISM_INTEGRITY_FAILURE; gain results are not interpreted
selection_logic.precedence: F (integrity) > E (A0 anomaly) > C (not reproduced) > A/B/D (selection)

run_accounting.counting_law: restore counts the continuation run (uninterrupted reference is a sub-step); partition counts tick10+direct (tick1 reuses the primary run); replay counts the REPLAY execution per variant

discipline_law.no_parameter_search: only 0, .10, .20; no .05/.08/.12/.15, no binary search, no fitting
discipline_law.optimization_target: responsive, bounded, recoverable, not dominated by event count, not persistently elevated after significance decayed — NOT maximum activation/AUC

zero_model_law: No OpenAI, Ollama, DeepSeek, Qwen or any evaluator/LLM call exists anywhere in E2A. Real model calls: 0.
production_isolation_law: Production source diff relative to the required baseline is empty; only research/experiments/affect-activation-mapping-e2a/ and evals/conformance/affect-activation-mapping-e2a.test.ts may change (plus the mechanical isolation-guard authorization edits in the E1/E2 harness files, documented in the manifest).
